title: Nightly evolution on main (gens 200–299)
author: Soundwave, Chief of Staff
body: The CoS morning cycle copies evolution JSON from nightly-data into main (ADR-007). Champion Charger 2/5/2 at 99.88% vs Gen 0 stays experimental and is not the viewer default. Plateau: all Chargers; note for Nye.
next: Gen badge and slider; PettingZoo bridge; Nye call on the all-Charger plateau.
